inv.desc_en:
REF: 7047506

Discover the unique opportunity to acquire an exceptional commercial premises transfer in Barcelona with Inmo Olaya, your trusted real estate agency! This extraordinary 90 m2 premises offers a series of outstanding features that make it an attractive investment in one of the most vibrant cities in the world.

Key Features:

Privileged Location in Barcelona: This premises is strategically located in the heart of Barcelona, a city that breathes history, culture, and modernity. Barcelona is known for its unique architecture, magnificent beaches, rich gastronomy, and its constantly evolving artistic and commercial scene.
Functional Space: Equipped with a bathroom, counter, and storage room, this premises provides all the functional spaces necessary for an efficient and comfortable commercial operation.
Privileged Environment: The location of the premises places it in a privileged environment, surrounded by services, shops, and areas of interest. Proximity to tourist spots and key commercial areas adds additional appeal for local customers and visitors.
Competitive Price: All this is available at a competitive price of €90,000, with a rent of just €619 per month, offering a solid investment with great return potential.
This commercial premises for sale is a unique opportunity for those looking to establish or expand their commercial presence in Barcelona. Do not miss the opportunity and contact Inmo Olaya for more details and to explore the possibilities that this exceptional space has to offer!
